_doc: tools/import_equipment.gd reads this: one sheet per tier, <tier>.png here (ui/art.gd EQUIP_TIERS), every sheet the same layout: the items in one row, left → right as items, on a solid magenta backdrop (the corners' colour) → assets/icons/equipment/<slot>_<tier>.png. background: tools/import_frames.gd key_background() options (holeMin: the smallest enclosed pocket of backdrop keyed as a hole); despill.hueRange: the purple-tinted outline px next to the backdrop turn grey / black (the art has no purple); split: anchor (a big piece is ≥ anchor × the largest), gap (big pieces whose x ranges overlap or are at most this many empty px columns apart are one item: a pair of gloves / boots), join (a small piece touching an item's box grown by this many px is part of it; others, the ✦ sparkle, are dropped), cuts (optional: the x of the item boundaries in sheet px); size / margin: the icon and its free border (the weapon icons' 128 / 6); sparkles: stars [[x, y, r]] in icon px per tier (the old painted icons' positions), colour [r, g, b, a], slots. See the tool's header and assets/README.md.
